_SecretsNote: Jwt:Key and Security:Pepper below are DEV-ONLY PLACEHOLDERS — this file is committed to a public repo and shipped inside the published server zip, so real secrets must NEVER be written here. Production deployments MUST override both via environment variables (Jwt__Key, Security__Pepper — ASP.NET Core's double-underscore convention) or a local, gitignored appsettings.Production.json. The app refuses to start in the Production environment if either still equals its placeholder value.
_JwtSyncNote: This Jwt block MUST stay byte-identical to every MyriaServer realm's appsettings.json Jwt block — realms trust tokens minted here purely via this shared signing key, with no live call back to this service. If you change one, change all.
_AdminSyncNote: Admin:InternalSecret below is a DEV-ONLY PLACEHOLDER. It MUST stay byte-identical to every realm's Admin:InternalSecret — this service sends it as the X-Internal-Secret header when calling each realm's /api/admin/characters/{username} endpoint on account deletion. Real value must come from the Admin__InternalSecret environment variable or a gitignored appsettings.Production.json, never this file.
_PasswordResetNote: PublicBaseUrl is the address USERS can reach this service at - the password-reset links the admin site shows are built from it (<PublicBaseUrl>/reset-password#token=...). Set the real public https URL in appsettings.Production.json or via PasswordReset__PublicBaseUrl.
